name: stepboard-tests
description: Headless browser checks for the panel. The app itself lives in ui/.

scripts.pretest: npm --prefix ui run lint && npm --prefix ui run build
scripts.test: s=0; node tests/proxy.mjs || s=1; uv run python tests/typed.py || s=1; for t in security parity regressions drag-select resilience; do node tests/$t.mjs || s=1; done; exit $s
